relationships.subject: L-655,708
relationships.evidence_quote: The drug produced an antiallodynic effect in nerve-injured female rats and mice, and a lower effect in males.

relationships.subject: nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Nerve injury increased α<sub>5</sub> -GABA<sub>A</sub> mRNA and protein in female dorsal root ganglia (DRG) and decreased them in DRG and spinal cord of males.

relationships.subject: DNA methyltransferases
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological inhibition of DNA methyltransferases increased α<sub>5</sub> -GABA<sub>A</sub> receptor and enabled L-655,708 antinociceptive effect in male rats.

relationships.subject: 17beta-estradiol
relationships.evidence_quote: Ovariectomy decreased α<sub>5</sub> -GABA<sub>A</sub> receptor and estrogen receptor α protein in DRG of neuropathic female rats, while E2 enhanced them.

key_findings: Spinal alpha5-GABAA inverse agonist L-655,708 is antiallodynic mainly in female nerve-injured rodents; effect depends on estradiol.
Nerve injury increases alpha5-GABAA gene methylation in males only, and DNMT inhibition restores receptor and drug effect in males.
